WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT tr.tradereg
    FROM trader tr
    WHERE 
        -- High-Risk Trader Profile: (TLE > 5.0 AND risklevel = 'Aggressive') OR DTR > 0.5
        ((trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::numeric > 5.0
